attchmntText: Panacea Biotec Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Panacea Biotec Limited published extracts of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in Business Standard and Desh Sewak newspapers on November 16, 2026. Gemstone Investments Limited reported a net profit of 168.01 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 255.72 lakhs in the previous year. B and A Limited reported a net profit of 2,480.63 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Valson Industries Limited reported a net loss of 0.48 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Visdem Technosys Limited reported a net profit of 491.88 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. KCL Infra Projects Limited reported a net profit of 130.35 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Altaf Hussain Siddiqui issued a public notice regarding a lost Agreement for Sale dated December 15, 2025.

attchmntText: Panacea Biotec Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Panacea Biotec Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors met on November 14, 2026, to consider the results, which were reviewed by the Audit Committee and subjected to a limited review by statutory auditors. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue from operations was 38,924 lakh rupees, compared to 30,783 lakh rupees in the previous year. Consolidated net profit after tax stood at 1,411 lakh rupees, versus a loss of 1,005 lakh rupees in the corresponding period last year. Earnings per share were 2.27 rupees, compared to a loss of 1.62 rupees previously. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.
